text: Claude AI ka har important option samajhna hai?
Toh ye video aapke liye hai!
Left sidebar mein New se nayi chat shuru hoti hai,
aur Search se purani chats dhoondh sakte hain.
Projects, Artifacts aur Code bhi yahin milte hain.
Neeche apne naam par click karke Settings milti hai.
Plus button se files aur photos add kar sakte hain.
Yahan Chat aur Cowork mode hai,
aur yahan se model chuniye, jaise Opus 5.5.
Sidebar ka Code option Claude Code ke liye hai.
Claude Code terminal mein bhi chalta hai.
Ye project files samajhta hai, code likhta hai
aur bugs debug karne mein help karta hai.
Lekin yaad rakhiye, AI ka code hamesha verify kijiye.
File access aur commands permissions par depend karte hain.
Agli videos mein har option step by step.
